opening.argument: The speaker presents crypto programs as a way to receive frequent, ongoing payouts, saying, "I'm literally getting paid out all day, every day." He ties payout size directly to the amount invested: "Put a lot of money in, you get paid out a lot." He then urges viewers, "Get set up with your accounts, guys," while promoting a USI Tech package for upfront income and linking a mining-bot program to a "high yield investment." He also describes referral income, but the central pitch is participation in payout-generating investment programs. Although he cautions viewers not to invest more than they can lose, that warning does not undo the direct solicitation to join, fund accounts, and buy into the programs.
